findings.subject: EU-Ukraine Association Agreement revision
findings.assessment: The revised EU-Ukraine Association Agreement increased the annual duty-free sugar import quota to 100,000 t.
findings.contrary_evidence_or_test: Monitor actual import volumes from Ukraine to assess the real impact on EU sugar prices and Südzucker's sales.
findings.missing_data: Actual import volumes and price impacts from the increased quota.
findings.decision: Management must assess the competitive impact of the increased import quota on its sugar segment.

evidence.quote: Das angepasste Abkommen sieht vor, das jährliche zoll- freie Kontingent für Zucker von 20.070 t auf 100.000 t pro Jahr zu erhöhen.

findings.subject: EU-Mercosur Agreement
findings.assessment: The EU-Mercosur Agreement lowers the tariff on Brazil's sugar import quota to zero and creates a new duty-free quota for Paraguay.
findings.contrary_evidence_or_test: Track the legal review process and potential delays in ratification to determine the timeline for market impact.
findings.missing_data: Final ratification status and actual import volumes post-agreement.
findings.decision: Management should prepare for potential market disruptions due to increased sugar imports from Mercosur countries.

evidence.quote: der Zoll für 180.000 t des bestehenden Einfuhrkontingents Brasiliens von 98 €/t auf 0 €/t gesenkt wird und - Paraguay ein neues zollfreies Einfuhrkontingent von jährlich 10.000 t Rohrohrzucker für die Raffination erhält.

findings.assessment: The working capital inflow resulted essentially from the expanded factoring program.

findings.to_node: Dairy, ice cream, and beverage customers

findings.contrary_evidence_or_test: Assess customer satisfaction and repeat orders to gauge the effectiveness of the collaboration strategy.
findings.missing_data: Specific customer feedback and order volumes from key accounts.

findings.missing_data: Final agreement terms and actual export volumes post-ratification.
findings.decision: Management should evaluate the potential benefits of reduced tariffs on non-protected sectors.

evidence.quote: Sensible Wirtschaftssektoren werden nicht in das Abkommen einbezogen, empfindliche europäische Agrarsektoren werden vollständig geschützt und Produkte wie Rindfleisch, Geflügel- fleisch, Reis und Zucker von der Liberalisierung im Rahmen des Abkommens vollständig ausgenommen.
